mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals labor market weakness that triggers Federal Reserve rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as equity valuations adjust to accommodative policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production below 98.0 and housing starts below 870.0 indicates broad economic contraction, prompting monetary easing that generates positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when INDPRO < 98.0 AND HOUST < 870.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth above 134,000 thousand persons indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 134,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 850.0 thousand units signal weakening residential demand, triggering Federal Reserve policy accommodation that generates positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when HOUST < 850.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 860.0 and CPI index above 232.0 indicates stagflation risk, prompting dovish monetary policy that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 860.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 232.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 98.0 indicates economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds from weakening supply conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
